titulo: New York City police seek suspect in fatal subway station shooting
cuerpo: Suspect shot a man in his 30s on the E train platform of the 53rd Street-7th Avenue subway station, according to NYPD A man was shot and killed in a New York City subway station Saturday afternoon, and the New York police department is searching for the suspect. The suspect fatally shot a man in his 30s on the E train platform of the 53rd Street-7th Avenue subway station, according to a statement from the NYPD . Continue reading...
